title: The Summer You Were There
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shizuku, a depressed high schooler, is caught throwing away her novel by classmate Kaori, who proposes they fake-date to give Shizuku inspiration. Their pretend relationship becomes real while Shizuku confronts her past of hurting a classmate, Ruri, and Kaori's serious illness. Seven Seas publishes it in English; Okazu lists warnings for suicide, terminal illness, death, grief and bullying.
life_message: It holds up love, honest reckoning with past harm and choosing to keep living after loss.
